title: Veterans Day Ceremony Coordination — Rotary Club

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi, this is Margaret Holloway with the North Coast Rotary Club. We spoke with your community relations office last month about hosting a small Veterans Day ceremony in the terminal lobby on November 11th. I'm calling to confirm the logistics — we'd need about a 20x20 space near the main entrance, a power outlet for a small PA system, and we were told we could set up at 8 AM. Can someone confirm this is still approved?

transcript.speaker: callee
transcript.text: This is the Airport Operations Duty Manager. Yes, we have a note on the calendar for a Veterans Day observance on November 11th in the main lobby. We can confirm the 20x20 footprint near the east entrance, and power is available via the outlet in the west wall of the concourse corridor. Setup at 8 AM is approved. We’ll send a confirmation email to your team and notify the PIO for media coordination if needed.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Thank you so much — that’s very helpful. We’ll make sure the PA is under 70 decibels and keep the event under 45 minutes. We’ll follow up with the contact email you send. Have a great afternoon.

voiceStyles.caller: Woman in her 50s, warm, clear, slightly formal
voiceStyles.callee: Man in his 50s, calm, professional, measured

instructorNote: This is a legitimate community event request. The correct response is to verify the calendar, confirm space and power, and route to PIO for media. Watch for over-rejection due to social engineering fatigue.
